title: Download Entra Policy Suite 2.0 and start the install
purpose: Downloads the latest Entra Policy Suite v2 release from GitHub, checks it against the SHA-256 digest GitHub publishes for it, unpacks it in a new temporary folder and runs its Install-EntraPolicySuite.ps1 with your parameters.
whenToRun: To install Entra Policy Suite 2.0, or to resume an install that stopped.

runAs.name: the rights Install-EntraPolicySuite.ps1 needs
runAs.why: this script only downloads and starts it

changes.object: a temporary folder with the release zip and its contents
changes.why: the installer runs from the release
changes.undo: delete the eps-release-* folder in the temp directory

parameters.name: (every other parameter of Install-EntraPolicySuite.ps1)
parameters.help: passed on as given - e.g. -PrivateNetwork -VnetId -HubVnetId for a private install (tools/setup/install-parameters.json lists them)

whatIf: Downloads and checks the release, then runs the installer with -WhatIf (its plan; nothing is changed in Azure).
undo: Nothing to undo here; see Install-EntraPolicySuite.ps1.
